## Batch 11 authored

The A and B pages contain 19 items: 16 A-page items and 3 worked examples. The real expected-error and power branches are proved. The required normalized-complex expectation branches remain explicitly **escalated** because the sharp complex Gaussian product bound has no complete proof or exact alternative here.

The proposed missing supplier is `lem-normalized-complex-scaled-gaussian-product-expectation`. It must prove the stated sharp bound for fixed compatible complex \(S,T\) and variance-one normalized complex Gaussian \(G\), or give a complete alternative proof of the assigned expectation. This affects the normalized-complex branches of `thm-gaussian-rangefinder-expected-spectral-error` and `thm-gaussian-power-rangefinder-expected-error`.

Batch evidence is in the [pages manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-11.pages.json>), [coverage ledger](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-11.coverage.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-11.proof-contracts.json>), [cross-batch evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-11.cross-batch-dependencies.json>) and [authoring notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-11.notes.md>).

The source ledger records four full-text treatments: [Halko–Martinsson–Tropp](https://users.oden.utexas.edu/~pgm/Pubs/2010_HMT_random_review.pdf), [Martinsson–Tropp](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2002.01387), [Mahoney](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1608.04481) and [Chevet](https://www.numdam.org/item/SAF_1977-1978____A14_0.pdf). All four passed `source-fetch-check --stamp`.

## Checks and remaining blockers

All 16 proof-bearing items passed precheck; `proof-layout` found 0 defects across 19 changed items and 44 proof steps. Strict proof-contract validation passed 16/16 with no warnings. Content policy, manifest dependencies, coverage, source fetch and the batch-local dependency-level check also passed.

Step 1 records mark **17 items ready** and the two full-field theorems **escalated**. These records are construction evidence, not independent approval.

The whole-run dependency-level check still fails on other batches: 74 empty inventories and 10 mismatched item levels, listed in the notes; no batch 11 item appears in its errors. Batch 16’s HIER inventory is still empty. Batch 17’s SKETCH carriers are now present; I checked the Gaussian-tail and OSE proofs and recorded their interfaces. SKETCH derives its own embedding bound and does not use the NA-08 expected-error theorem.

The autopilot run remains at `1-scaffold` under the owner repair and recertification blocker. I left the plan, published content and engine state unchanged.
